title_fa: بدسوزی تصادفی یا چندسیلندری در دور آرام
diagnostic_steps: Confirm stored and pending DTCs and freeze-frame data.
Inspect plugs, coils and connectors using correct service information.
Check intake leaks and fuel trims under comparable conditions.
Perform cylinder contribution, compression or leak-down tests as appropriate.
Test injector electrical and hydraulic performance using approved procedures.
safety_notes: A flashing malfunction indicator lamp can indicate catalyst-damaging misfire. Avoid continued driving under active severe misfire; diagnose promptly. Live data alone does not identify a failed part.
